notes.title: Update?
notes.notes:
Look at this image.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45629070/ae9213f299c73b7698c73021ffef0077aa877988.png"]Notice anything different?


Here are the new Changes!Currently
Decided to make the puller information much bigger. You can now properly see the seconds left!

There's also a card history on the bottom left to help blame someone for your misfortune when someone pulls a snipe card.


Future
There will be 4 more cards! One of them is pretty funny. The new Drag card will obliterate both the puller and the holder of that card if the puller pulls it. This terrifying card should make the puller more weary, but will also make the holder also scared. This can result in funny situations.



There will also be language support for more languages.

Spanish

Simplified Chinese

Russian


All coming in October!
This should be accompanied by a really good discount or something better.
